prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve with style-transfer. This is the ONE TARGETED REVISION of input 1, the drafted 74x100 dialogue portrait. Inputs 2-5 are the approved four pixel style anchors. Keep this SAME person's sex, identifying hair, clothing palette and closed mouth, but redraw framing and facial expression; do not just enlarge existing crop.
STRICT TARGET: 74:100 portrait ratio, transparent, coarse hard-edge connected pixel planes designed for 74x100 logical pixels. Preserve the entire head/hair/ear silhouette. Head top y=3, sides at least 2 transparent logical pixels margin. Make FACIAL AREA larger inside the head by reducing hair/headcloth bulk, not enlarging the outer silhouette. Move the chin down to about y=90. Only 3–5 logical pixels of neck beneath the jaw, then NARROW collar ending at y=98. No clavicle, chest, shoulders, long throat or garment area.
MOST IMPORTANT EYES: replace every bright cream/white sclera block with one tiny NARROW DARK WARM TAUPE slit, subdued near surrounding skin-shadow value. NO WHITE, no ivory, no bright pale beige, no catchlights. Eye opening at most 1 logical pixel high; pupils dark brown with a single restrained upper lid, not thick mascara. Both eyes quietly readable but never the brightest parts.
Only 4-5 large skin-tone planes. Carve nose, cheekbone, mature lower eye plane, jaw and chin in big solid connected shapes. No tiny wrinkles, stipple, dither, stripe texture, scratchy strands, blur, antialias or gradients. Hair organized into 3 broad solid masses. Maximum 32 matte working colors. No text or props. Keep restrained dark medieval four-reference style.
TIVER, female practical kitchen care worker in her FORTIES. Preserve the warm OFF-WHITE tightly tied HEADSCARF with compact knot behind the right-side ear, brown hair, warm skin, BROAD CHEEKS and SQUARE WIDE JAW, rust-red dress edge and gray apron neckline. Make cheek width and blunt chin stronger, face definitely mature, not cute. Correct expression to CALM UNYIELDING SELF-POSSESSION: eyebrows nearly HORIZONTAL with inner ends level or very slightly DOWN, remove raised inner brows and forehead worry wedge. Straight gently pressed closed lips, no smile and no scowl. Reduce headscarf width and top bulk enough to enlarge forehead/face; simplify folds to 3 broad beige masses. Remove fine stray left curls; keep just one short broad temple lock. Entire scarf knot and visible ear must be within the frame with transparent side margins. Collar raised immediately beneath short jaw, no exposed upper chest. This is a sturdy calm caregiver who refuses being represented by others, not a sad person, leader or service mascot.
